provenance: Controlled authored development history, not naturally occurring or upstream-mined defects.

history.before:
def overlaps(self, other: Slot) -> bool:
        return self.start < other.end and other.start > self.end
history.after:
def overlaps(self, other: Slot) -> bool:
        return self.start < other.end and other.start < self.end

history.before:
def contains(self, point: int) -> bool:
        return self.start <= point
history.after:
def contains(self, point: int) -> bool:
        return self.start <= point < self.end

features.before:
def overlaps(self, other: Slot) -> bool:

features.description: Add strict overlap mode requiring more than single-point sharing; standard mode comparison accidentally inverted.
Add option to skip first occurrence in series; refactoring shifts all slot indices by one period.
Add optional seconds suffix; standard return uses total-minutes parameter instead of remainder.
Add ratio-mode utilization reporting; tuple branch returns free time instead of used time.
Add option to reject end-of-day 24:00; refactoring removes invalid-format exception guard.
Add reverse chronological ordering; default sort key drops slot component, breaking time ordering.
Add maximum gap count limit; refactoring drops trailing-gap check after the loop.
